description: Use for trip planning, logistics, event or outdoor decisions: returns the forecast for a location from the Norwegian Meteorological Institute (global coverage): current temperature, wind, humidity, cloud cover, pressure and symbol, an hourly series for the next N hours, and daily summaries (min/max temperature, total precipitation, dominant symbol). Give lat/lon, or a place name resolved via Wikidata. Times are UTC. Licensed CC BY 4.0: credit MET Norway. Paid tool: x402 USDC on Base, $0.002 per successful call; call without payment to receive the PaymentRequired object.

place.description: Place name (city, landmark), resolved via Wikidata. Give place or lat+lon.
